title: The Filmmakers at Wonder Dynamics Building AI for Filmmakers
excerpt: Wonder Dynamics co-founders Tye Sheridan and Nikola Todorovic discuss how their filmmaking backgrounds shaped Autodesk Flow Studio, an AI tool that transfers live-action performances onto CG characters while keeping artists in control and staying compatible with established VFX pipelines. A grounded look at AI-assisted performance-to-CG as a craft workflow, not a replacement.

title: Frame.io adds full-screen search and Comparison Viewer updates
excerpt: Adobe's Frame.io rolls out a dedicated full-screen search page with a toggle between standard and AI-powered search, plus Comparison Viewer updates, letting editors and post teams find and review footage across projects faster. A concrete workflow shift for how film/TV review-and-approval teams navigate media.

title: Introducing Layers
excerpt: Luma AI launched Layers, giving creators precision editing and element-by-element control over any AI-generated image inside its filmmaking toolset, rather than re-rolling a whole prompt. A craft-level capability that pushes generative work toward the directed, revisable control filmmakers and previs artists expect.
